changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_holiday ( id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, country VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, holiday_date DATE NOT NULL, local_name VARCHAR(128), name VARCHAR(128), is_global BOOL, version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (country, holiday_date) );
